workstreams.title: Worst-case DC, source, charge and power-state verification
workstreams.pass_rule: Every legal source/load state has positive voltage, current, thermal and protection margin at tolerance corners.
workstreams.physical_residual_owner: H5/H8 power-source, cell, current-step and rail measurements

workstreams.title: Startup, shutdown, handover, brownout, inrush and watchdog verification
workstreams.pass_rule: Every legal transition reaches a bounded safe state; every illegal or stalled transition fails closed with diagnosable state retention.
workstreams.physical_residual_owner: H8 sequenced bring-up, brownout, watchdog and unattended-operation captures

workstreams.title: Display, audio, IR, battery and Airband analog-corner verification
workstreams.pass_rule: Every selected analog path meets its stated amplitude, bandwidth, noise, load and fail-off limits at reproducible corners.
workstreams.physical_residual_owner: H5/H8 panel, acoustic, IR, cell-impedance and swept-RF measurements

workstreams.title: Digital levels, timing, loading and direct-i8080 verification
workstreams.pass_rule: Every digital boundary has positive level/timing margin, deterministic ownership and a recoverable reset/service state without payload contention.
workstreams.physical_residual_owner: H5/H8 far-end levels, eyes, bus traces, fixture access and service-path tests

workstreams.title: RF feeds, coexistence, quiet states and 3x nRF24 concurrency
workstreams.pass_rule: Each RF port has one bounded owner and quiet state; three nRF24 paths remain concurrently serviceable; no inactive path can transmit or load the active group unexpectedly.
workstreams.physical_residual_owner: H5/H8 VNA/feed loss, antenna identity, isolation, coexistence and real-TX evidence

workstreams.title: Thermal, single-fault and unattended-operation verification
workstreams.pass_rule: No accepted single fault defeats the independent hard-off path; thermal/watchdog faults remove hazardous power while preserving a readable cause when energy remains.
workstreams.physical_residual_owner: H8 controlled fault injection and thermal shutdown captures

workstreams.title: Cross-check, physical residual register and phase report
workstreams.pass_rule: All prior H3 workstreams pass on one source revision and every remaining uncertainty is physical-only with one downstream owner.
workstreams.physical_residual_owner: H4 joined review, then H5/H6/H8 as explicitly assigned
